unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፭ — Meraf 5: Grand Master of ቀ and በ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ቀ and በ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የቀ እና የበ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: QEBERO
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'QEBERO' (Jackal/Fox) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ቀበሮ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Fox' (Qebero). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]በሮ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ቀበሮ (pronounced Qe-be-ro).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ቀበሮ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Fox (Qebero)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ቀ', follow with 1st form 'በ', and end in 7th form 'ሮ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: BI'ER
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'BI'ER' (Pen/Stylus) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ቅ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the glottal native 6th form 'Q' sound of the ቀ family. Which symbol matches this silent/stopped form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ብዕር
games.instructions_en: Form the Amharic word for Pen (Bi'er)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 6th form 'ብ', followed by 6th form 'ዕ', and end in 6th form 'ር'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: BEG
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'BEG' (Sheep) with the correct Amharic word.
